description: Advanced Messaging Concept Development Basic Mobility Control Message is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Automobiles", published or maintained by U.S. Department of Transportation’s (USDOT) Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) Joint Program Office (JPO) -- Recommended citation: "Advanced Messaging Concept Development Team. (2016). Advanced Messaging Concept Development Basic Mobility Control Message. [Dataset]. Provided by ITS DataHub through Data.transportation.gov. Accessed YYYY-MM-DD from http://doi.org/10.21949/1504511". Contains all Basic Mobility Control Message (BMCMs) generated during the Advanced Messaging Concept Development (AMCD) field testing program. While there is no specific standard in existence that addresses the content of a BMCM, the following format was derived to control the configuration and content of BMMs requested from the vehicle. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Automobiles". It has 16 columns, among them Time Sent, OBU ID, Requested BMM Data, Periodic Triggering, BMM Pack, Test No.. The portal shows 2017-06-06 as the last data update. Attribution given: U.S. Department of Transportation’s (USDOT) Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) Joint Program Office (JPO) -- Recom. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
